text.tspan: Three CloudFormation resources. Revisions are immutable; the endpoint routes traffic to up to two of them.
Only a name, unique across all Regions in the account
Updated in place in a few seconds
Immutable: changes create a new revision
Immutable: changes create a new revision
Change code or revision settings → CloudFormation creates a new revision and shifts the endpoint to it.
Canary or rollback → change only the endpoint's revision weights (no redeploy).
